title: No Kings Protest, Honesdale, PA
description:
In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings. NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.

🚨On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.🚨

The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.

On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings. Check out nokings.org for more information.

A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.

title: Tesla Takedown Tuesday: Montlake Overpass!
description:
**Join us for Tesla Takedown Tuesday and help send a clear message to Musk and Trump: We're not backing down.**

Our protests have helped force Musk from DC but our work is far from done. **Tesla's stock is UP because investors think we're going to fade away** while Musk buys our elections, spews hate and lies on his social network, and bullies even conservative members of Congress into giving Trump the power of a KING.

Join us on the pedestrian bridge over Montlake Blvd between the Burke Gilman Trail and the UW Montlake Parking Lot (E01).

**Every day brings a new crisis of corruption, chaos, or cruelty. Share your thoughts on the damage Musk and Trump are inflicting:**

- attacks on due process and immigrants
- abdication of checks and balances by Congress and the Courts
- theft of our data by Musk and DOGE
- corruption by the President

Bring your own sign or borrow one of ours, we always have extras!

See you Tuesday! 

— Robin

PS. For our full schedule of protests, check out DefundMusk.com.
PPS. We're also at the overpass on other weekdays at the same time.

Tesla Takedown is a peaceful protest movement. We oppose violence, vandalism and destruction of property. Please treat Tesla drivers with respect as they are most likely on our side!

#TeslaTakedown #BoycottTesla #DefundMusk

title: Please Join “SHARING OUR STORIES (SOS) – LAUNCH EVENT” Zoom: Tuesday, June 3, @7:00–8:30 PM central
description:
#### Please Join “SHARING OUR STORIES (SOS) – LAUNCH EVENT” Zoom: Tuesday, June 3, @7:00–8:30 PM central

_We are thrilled to announce the launch of the NWSOFA Indivisible Sharing Our Stories (SOS) Group!_

Join us for our very first meeting on Tuesday, June 3, 2025, from 7:00 to 8:30 PM CST via Zoom. This new initiative is dedicated to amplifying the voices of those whose lives have been impacted by the harmful policies of the Trump administration. By coming together, we aim to foster empathy, spark meaningful change, and ensure that these crucial stories receive the attention they deserve.

#### Let us know you will be attending … RSVP here-> https://mobilize.us/s/4k7MyW-

Personal stories have the power to move hearts and minds in ways that facts and figures alone cannot. By sharing real-life experiences, we humanize complex issues and inspire our communities to take action. Your story—or your help in sharing someone else’s—can make a difference, turning statistics into a call for compassion and justice.

We welcome everyone in our Indivisible community: whether you have a story to share, or skills in writing, content creation, administration, or leadership. Your involvement will help us collect, organize, and amplify these narratives across social media, legislative hearings, town halls, protests, and personal conversations. Every voice matters, and your participation will be invaluable as we work to create lasting change.

If you’re passionate about making a difference, please join us for this important kickoff meeting. Mark your calendars and be part of a movement that ensures every story is heard and every voice counts. 

#### Together, we can shine a light on the real-world impact of policy decisions—and help shape a better future for all.

title: NO KINGS - Wellsville, NY
description:
Join Rise Up Wellsville and the Allegany County Democratic Committee for a peaceful “No Kings Day” demonstration. 

We'll begin at Island Park at 2:00 p.m. We'll march with signs and chants to spend a few moments at the 417 overpass. 

Then we'll march on to the Fassett Greenspace, sharing signs, music, and a united community as cars drive by. 

At 3:00 p.m. we’ll read aloud the Declaration of Independence and the Constitution of the United States. 

We’re asking everyone to bring a donation of non-perishable food so we can fill an SUV hatchback for the Rushford Food Pantry. 

Please, no hateful rhetoric or nasty signs. Instead let’s focus on maintaining our precious democracy and the rule of law. No clowns. No kings.

title: NO KINGS! Bloomsburg March & Rally
description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**On June 14th, we’re showing up everywhere he isn’t—to say no thrones, no crowns, no kings. In Bloomsburg, join Sunrise Bloomsburg and Action Together NEPA for a march up Market Street followed by a rally at the Columbia County Courthouse to say NO KINGS IN AMERICA!**
Check out nokings.org for more information.

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*


**BLOOMSBURG EVENT INFORMATION**
This action will include a march and a rally. The march will begin at the Bloomsburg Town Park (meet in the parking lot at the end of Market Street), go up Market, and end at the Columbia County Courthouse at 35 West Main Street. 


If you'd like to join the march but don't want or aren't able to walk the whole length, feel free to join us anywhere along Market Street! Some folks will be gathering and joining from the closed Social Security Office at 700 Market Street, or join from any spot along the way!

Following the march, we will have a rally with speakers at the Columbia County Courthouse, which will begin at approximately 1:30pm (slightly flexible depending upon marchers' arrival). You may also feel free to join us directly at the Courthouse beginning at 1pm. 

Please dress comfortably-wear lightweight clothing and shoes comfortable for walking/standing. There are spots to sit at the Courthouse, but if you'd like to be guaranteed a place to sit, we would recommend bringing a folding lawn chair. Organizers will provide water and snacks. 

**BRING SIGNS! **
Get creative with your signs - homemade handwritten signs are always the coolest! If you need some ideas, here are a few: 

NO KINGS IN AMERICA!

Stop the Shakedown!

United Against Kings

We are Not For Sale!

No Thrones. No Crowns. No Kings.

location.venue: Public sidewalk in front of Boland Dept of Veterans Affairs Medical Center

description:
Let's show our support to those who took an oath to support the constitution and served our nation!

On this 81st Anniversary of D-Day and in solidarity with [Unite for Veterans rally]( https://www.unite4veterans.org/) in Washington, D.C. and [No Kings On D-Day rally](https://www.mobilize.us/mobilize/event/786222/) in Boston, join us at the **VA Medical Center in Leeds, MA** to honor veterans and active duty military who fought to defend the constitution. Veteran jobs, healthcare, and essential VA services are currently under attack. Today, we come together to support all our veterans, to let them know we care about them. 

This is a peaceful event, and violence of any kind will not be tolerated. Please feel free to bring signs with positive and supportive messages.  Bring your US Flags and wave them proudly. 

Parking: parking is available in the VA parking lot to the left of the entrance. Please do not park on the road or anywhere else on VA property.

title: 6/8 Carroll Gardens Meet & Greet
description:
Please join hosts Elana Black & Greg Borofsky in Carroll Gardens on June 8th for a Meet & Greet with Maya Kornberg, Democratic candidate for New York City Council District 39!

Maya Kornberg is a new mom, advocate, author, educator, and political scientist running for New York City Council District 39 to bring a results-driven progressive approach to City Hall. Maya will fight to protect our democracy, increase childcare access, tackle the housing affordability crisis, improve our schools, build green infrastructure, and create safer streets through accountable policing. Maya has dedicated her career to making democracy work better for the people it's meant to serve, including combating political violence and creating more responsive government processes. Her work has been featured in the Washington Post, Newsweek, the Hill, and NPR. An educator, Maya has taught graduate and undergraduate political courses at NYU, Georgetown, Oxford, and American University. Maya and her spouse rent an apartment in Park Slope where they are raising their newborn son.

Please RSVP for each guest in your party. Don't hesitate to reach out to sam@mayaforcouncil.com with any questions!
